question: What claim about the uniqueness of this knowledge requires that no equal knowledge will exist again or at all?
premises: Knowledge equal to this exists in no form.
It will not exist otherwise in the future.
inference: No knowledge equal to this knowledge will come to be, now or again.
uncertainties: The scope of 'again' is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this; there will be none again.
